inputs.sbc_source: J-GAAP consolidated cash-flow statement (FY2025 annual, H1 FY2026 tanshin) carries no share-based payment add-back. The only equity award is a restricted-stock grant of 31,600 shares on 2026-05-19 (~JPY 73m at market, 0.01% of revenue) -- genuinely immaterial, set to 0 and kept visible as an explicit 0% row.
inputs.share_count_basis: 169,360,439 issued less 13,130,829 treasury = 156,229,610 at 2026-06-30 (H1 FY2026 tanshin). Diluted EPS is reported as '-' (no dilutive securities), so basic = fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is zero so there is nothing to expense or dilute; buyback_cash of JPY 939m (FY2025) is the actual treasury purchase, not an authorisation.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows. 10y JGB ~1.7% + 5.5% JPY ERP x beta ~1.1 gives a cost of equity ~7.8%; pre-tax cost of debt 1.6% (FY2025 interest expense JPY 2.9bn on ~JPY 180bn average interest-bearing debt), ~1.1% after tax; market weights ~74/26 give a bottom-up WACC ~6.1%. The house uses 8.0%: the ~9% JPY keiretsu-industrial reference less 1pp for the government/defence-weighted Wireless mix (half of revenue) that is less cyclical than an auto supplier. Risk is charged here ONCE -- the same 8.0% is used in all three scenarios; cyclicality, the Micro Devices turnaround and conglomerate discount are expressed in the scenario flows and weights, not in per-scenario discount rates.
inputs.lease_treatment: J-GAAP filer: operating leases are expensed inside operating profit and there is no lease-liability line on the consolidated balance sheet (Dec-2025 or Jun-2026). No lease adjustment is made in either the flows or the bridge -- treatment (B) by construction, with the lease cost already inside the EBITDA margin. lease_cost_pct_path is omitted (0).
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests of JPY 30,203m (2026-06-30 balance sheet, line 350) are deducted ONCE in the equity bridge at book. Flows are modelled fully consolidated (segment operating profit is consolidated), so no attributable-only leakage driver is applied. NCI profit share was JPY 977m in FY2025 and JPY 1,443m in H1 FY2026 -- a 3-6% leak that book NCI of JPY 30bn covers.
inputs.non_operating_assets: Investment securities of JPY 86,264m at 2026-06-30 (line 297; AFS at fair value plus equity-method affiliates at book) are added in the bridge NET of the ~30.6% deferred tax on the JPY 36,560m unrealised AFS valuation difference (line 344): 86,264 - 11,190 = JPY 75,074m. Matching-asset rule: because that asset is in the bridge, interest income (JPY 980m), dividend income (JPY 1,331m) and the equity-method profit share (JPY 4,078m, FY2025) are all EXCLUDED from the flows -- the component build starts from operating profit, which contains none of them. interest_income of 2,311 in this file is interest + dividend income combined (FY2025 P&L, line 801 of the cash-flow statement) and is what reduces reported_fcf to last_fcf. Retirement benefit asset (JPY 30,681m at Dec-2025) and retirement benefit liability (JPY 30,591m at Jun-2026) roughly offset and are left out of the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted -- routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical: industrials' with owner-fcf-adaptations.md applied (JPY WACC, J-GAAP leases, NCI once, matching-asset rule for the securities portfolio, SBC-zero). Sum-of-the-parts was considered and rejected: six of seven segments are sub-scale (Chemicals, Textiles, Brakes, Precision Instruments each < JPY 60bn revenue with thin or negative margins) and the only two that would carry a distinct multiple -- Wireless (JPY 252bn, 50% of revenue) and Real Estate (lumpy project gains, JPY 10-18bn revenue) -- are modelled explicitly through the consolidated margin path and the Real Estate normalisation in year 1-2 rather than through separate exit multiples the market has never paid for Nisshinbo. FIRST BUILD (no prior DCF). BASIS: FY0 = FY2025 (calendar year, Dec year-end since the 2018 nine-month transition). Revenue FY2025 JPY 502,339m; operating profit JPY 26,401m; D&A JPY 25,599m + goodwill amortisation JPY 469m = EBITDA JPY 52,469m (10.4% margin); capex (cash) JPY 16,839m; cash taxes paid JPY 5,081m. FY2026 GUIDANCE (reaffirmed 2026-08-06): sales JPY 511,000m, OP JPY 21,000m, NP JPY 10,000m, capex JPY 23.9bn, depreciation JPY 27.0bn, ~JPY 6bn extraordinary restructuring loss (Micro Devices early retirement). H1 FY2026 OP was already JPY 30,274m, so unchanged guidance implies an H2 operating LOSS of JPY 9.3bn; H2 has been +JPY 8-10bn in each of FY2024 and FY2025 (Wireless is Q1-heavy on Japan's March government year-end). The base case therefore takes FY2026 OP ~JPY 31-32bn (EBITDA margin 11.5%), not the guided 21bn; the bear case (10.0% EBITDA, OP ~24bn) still sits above guidance. NON-RECURRING: FY2025 OCF included JPY 10,463m of interest and dividends received (mostly equity-method affiliate dividends) and a JPY 5.7bn receivables release; neither is carried forward -- the year-1 owner-FCF margin from the component build (~3.5-4%) is below the FY2025 reported 6.5% for that reason. WORKING CAPITAL: net trade working capital (receivables 152.7bn + inventories 161.7bn - payables 62.0bn at Dec-2025) is ~50% of revenue; wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-40%) so growth consumes cash. PORTFOLIO: TMD Friction (European brakes) sold Nov-2023 (Brakes revenue 178.5bn -> 58.2bn), Mechatronics molded-products business transferred to Endeavour United 2026-10-01 (inside Precision Instruments, guided 55.4bn -> 51.5bn in FY2026 with a fuller-year effect in FY2027, absorbed in the low year-2 growth). SANITY ANCHOR: at the current price the market cap is ~JPY 360bn, EV ~JPY 398bn (after the securities portfolio and NCI), i.e. ~7.6x FY2025 EBITDA and ~6.3x TTM EBITDA (52.5 + 42.7 - 31.1 = 64.1bn); the shares have doubled off the 52-week low on the Wireless/defence re-rating.

equity_bridge.item: Investment securities (AFS at fair value + equity-method affiliates at book), net of ~30.6% deferred tax on the JPY 36,560m unrealised AFS gain
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 balance sheet line 297 (86,264) less 11,190 tax; income from these assets (interest, dividends, equity-method profit) is excluded from the flows
H1 FY2026 balance sheet line 350; flows are fully consolidated so NCI is charged once, here

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr rounded; equity CAGR rejected as a growth proxy (see notes)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 4.7% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 1.9% and EPS 5yr CAGR 1.8%. The equity growth is mostly AFS valuation gains (JPY 36.6bn unrealised at Jun-2026) and yen-weakness translation gains, not retained operating earnings, so it is not used as the growth anchor.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on calendar-year FY2020->FY2025 (5yr) and FY2022->FY2025 (3yr); the pre-2019 March year-end history and the FY2018 nine-month stub are excluded. Revenue 3yr is negative because of the Nov-2023 TMD Friction divestiture (Brakes 178.5bn -> 58.2bn). Owner-FCF CAGRs are not computable: the Metrics CSV carries capex only from FY2024, so only two annual owner-FCF points exist (FY2024 ~JPY 1.0bn, FY2025 ~JPY 30.2bn, both distorted by working-capital swings and FY2025's JPY 10.5bn of dividends received). EPS 3yr is depressed by the FY2022 Micro Devices peak (segment OP JPY 8.9bn vs -5.5bn in FY2025).

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = FY2026 guidance (+1.7% to JPY 511bn, reaffirmed Aug-2026). Y2 +0.5% nets the full-year loss of the Mechatronics molded-products revenue (transferred 2026-10-01) and a smaller Real Estate slate against Wireless growth (Solutions & Defence guided +5%). Y3-Y4 2.5% as the defence/disaster-prevention order book converts; fades to 1.5% by Y7, about Japanese nominal GDP, and to 1.0% terminal.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 EBITDA 10.4%; H1 FY2026 15.7% (seasonal peak). Y1 11.5% = OP ~JPY 31.8bn, well above the sandbagged JPY 21bn guidance (which needs an H2 loss that has not occurred in any recent year) but below the H1 run-rate. Y2 dips to 11.3% for the guided R&D/HR step-up and Real Estate normalising to ~JPY 6bn OP. Matures at 12.0% EBITDA (~7% OP margin) -- a structural step up from the 3-5% OP margins of FY2019-24, justified by TMD Friction gone, JPY 3bn JRC and JPY 4bn Micro Devices fixed-cost cuts already executed, and Micro Devices at about break-even; deliberately short of management's 10% OP-margin target, which is the bull case.
base.capex_da_rationale: FY2026 plan: capex JPY 23.9bn (4.7%), depreciation JPY 27.0bn (5.3%). Converge to 4.9% each by Y6 -- a mature industrial reinvests roughly at D&A.
base.tax_rationale: 31% cash tax on EBIT, the Japanese statutory effective rate (~30.6%); FY2025 cash taxes paid (JPY 5.1bn) were held down by restructuring losses that are not in the forward flows.
base.wc_rationale: Net trade working capital ~50% of revenue; -40% capture on the revenue change (receivables + inventories grow faster than payables, with Q4 government deliveries inflating year-end receivables).
base.terminal_rationale: g 1.0% (JPY nominal growth). Cap 14x FCF, the low end of the house 12-15x cyclical band, for a conglomerate that has rarely traded above ~7x EV/EBITDA; the build reports which bound.

bull.rationale: Management's own 'Blueprint': 10% consolidated OP margin (15% EBITDA) reached by Y7, Wireless OP JPY 30bn by FY2030 (from 17.7bn), Micro Devices back to profit, defence budget growth sustained. Growth 4% in Y3-Y4 as the Wireless order book compounds. Same 8.0% WACC (risk is in the flows, not the rate); g 1.5%.

bear.rationale: FY2026 lands nearer guidance (EBITDA 10.0%, OP ~24bn) as H2 absorbs the R&D step-up and restructuring drag; FY2027 revenue -2% on the Mechatronics carve-out plus an auto-production downturn hitting Brakes/Precision; Micro Devices stays loss-making through the semiconductor cycle; Real Estate pipeline thins; 'one-off' restructuring charges keep recurring. Margin settles at 9.5% EBITDA (~4.5% OP), i.e. the FY2019-24 range -- the transformation fails to lift earning power. Same 8.0% WACC; g 0.5%.

scenario_narratives.base: Nisshinbo's value hinges on whether the Wireless and Communications engine (Japan Radio + KOKUSAI DENKI, half of revenue) holds the margin step-up it showed in FY2025-H1 FY2026 as Japan's defence and disaster-prevention budgets grow, while the materials and semiconductor legacy stops bleeding. Base: Wireless OP stays in the JPY 17-22bn range, Micro Devices reaches break-even on the JPY 4bn fixed-cost cut, Real Estate normalises to a JPY 5-7bn contribution, and the Mechatronics carve-out trims FY2027 revenue. Consolidated EBITDA margin matures at 12% (OP ~7%) -- better than the 3-5% decade but short of the 10% OP target. FY2026 guidance of JPY 21bn OP is treated as sandbagged given JPY 30.3bn was earned in H1.
scenario_narratives.bull: The 'Blueprint for Transformation' delivers: consolidated OP margin reaches the 10% target by Y7 (Wireless JPY 30bn by FY2030 on defence/disaster-DX demand, Micro Devices profitable, materials portfolio pruned to the profitable core), revenue compounds 3-4% through the order book, and the TSE capital-efficiency push adds buybacks. EBITDA margin 15% at maturity, g 1.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: The H1 FY2026 margin proves a seasonal/FX peak: Wireless profit slips back toward JPY 10-13bn as R&D and headcount costs rise, Micro Devices stays loss-making through another semiconductor downcycle, the auto segments see a volume downturn and EV-transition pricing pressure, Real Estate project gains dry up, and restructuring charges recur every year. EBITDA margin settles at 9.5%, revenue flat to +1% -- the FY2019-24 earning power, and the conglomerate discount persists.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: the thesis rests on an unproven pivot (Micro Devices has lost money for several years, FY2026 guidance itself calls for lower OP, and restructuring charges have recurred every period), and H1 seasonality/FX flattered the latest print. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs three independent things to go right -- the 10% OP-margin target, a Micro Devices turnaround, and sustained defence budget growth. Base 50%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A JPY owner-FCF DCF on a diversified industrial whose earnings are being re-based upward by the exit from European brakes and by structural reform in Wireless and Micro Devices. The valuation deliberately uses operating profit as the starting point (so the JPY 86bn securities portfolio, its dividends and the equity-method income sit in the bridge, not the flows), charges NCI once in the bridge, holds the share count flat with SBC at an explicit 0%, and applies one JPY WACC (8.0%) across all scenarios so cyclicality and execution risk are priced in the flows and weights rather than stacked into the discount rate. The terminal multiple is capped at 14x FCF because the stock has rarely traded above ~7x EV/EBITDA and the market has never paid a compounder multiple for Nisshinbo. The large working-capital base (~50% of revenue) is charged against growth; real-estate project gains are normalised, not carried forward.
key_risks_to_valuation: FY2026 H2 seasonality: the model assumes H2 OP is positive (+JPY 1-8bn across scenarios); if guidance's implied H2 loss materialises, Y1 EBITDA margin drops ~1.5pp
Wireless margin durability: the H1 FY2026 margin benefited from yen weakness (JPY 200m OP per 1 yen) and a Q1-heavy government delivery schedule; a stronger yen or defence budget slippage erodes it
Micro Devices: a further JPY 5bn+ annual loss is a direct ~1pp EBITDA-margin hit; the restructuring benefit is assumed, not yet reported
Mechatronics carve-out and further divestitures change the revenue base; the FY2027 growth figure is an estimate pending disclosure of the transferred revenue
Securities portfolio at JPY 75bn net (JPY 480/share) is marked to a strong Japanese equity market; a 30% drawdown is ~JPY 145/share
Working-capital capture at -40% is a judgment; receivable timing on government contracts swings annual FCF by JPY 10-30bn
Terminal cap at 14x FCF binds in the bull/base cases; raising it to the Gordon value is a re-rating thesis the market has not historically paid for
